indicator.name: Emisiones de CO₂ per cápita
indicator.description: Emisiones anuales de CO₂ equivalente por habitante, excluido el uso de la tierra y los bosques.
indicator.null_policy: No se interpola ni se convierte en cero.
indicator.methodology: Emisiones territoriales de agricultura, energía, residuos e industria; excluye LULUCF y no mide la huella de consumo.

official_metadata.name: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions excluding LULUCF per capita (t CO2e/capita)
official_metadata.source_note: Total annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2), one of the six Kyoto greenhouse gases (GHG), from the agriculture, energy, waste, and industrial sectors, excluding LULUCF, standardized to carbon dioxide equivalent values divided by the economy's population. This measure excludes GHG fluxes caused by Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry (LULUCF), as these fluxes have larger uncertainties.
official_metadata.source_organization:
EDGAR (Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research) Community GHG Database, Joint Research Centre (JRC) - European Commission, uri: https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ghg2024, publisher: JRC European Commission, date published: 2024;
